title: Ready For A Rebound
summary: What are the prospects for clean Aframaxes? As we discussed in one of our Weekly Opinions last month (" Do You Want Coatings With That "), many shipowners that are interested in the Aframax tanker segment are choosing to build coated tankers (LR2s) to maintain the optionality to trade dirty or clean. In the first half of 2024, clean Aframax rates were very strong, albeit quite volatile.
